description: Only scans with a scan count strictly greater than 11 are kept.

d.request: For scans with `scancount > 11` that have a matching site, group by `scans.zoneref` and `sites.phasefactor`; compute the unrounded averages of non-null `scancount` and `pressratio`, then return the 10 groups with the highest average `pressratio`, placing null averages last.
d.sql: SELECT scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor, AVG(scans.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(scans.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.scancount > 11 GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

c.request: For scans whose `scancount` clears the 11-scan mark, linked to their sites through `scans.zoneref` = `sites.zoneregistry` (scans without a site left out), what are the average `scancount` and the average compression ratio (`pressratio`) for each site code (`scans.zoneref`) and historical phase (`sites.phasefactor`)? Ignore missing values and don't round. Show the site code, the phase and both averages for the 10 combinations with the highest average compression ratio, with missing values last. Only scans with a scan count strictly greater than 11 are kept.
c.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans AS s INNER JOIN sites AS si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount > 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

a.request: Join scans to their sites on `scans.zoneref` = `sites.zoneregistry`, dropping unmatched scans. Keep only scans whose `scancount` is more than 11. Group by site code (`scans.zoneref`) and historical phase (`sites.phasefactor`). For each group, give the site code, the phase, the average `scancount` and the average compression ratio (`pressratio`), each ignoring missing values. Sort by average compression ratio, highest first with missing last, keep the first 10 rows, and don't round.
a.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, t.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans AS s INNER JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount > 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.phasefactor ORDER BY AVG(s.pressratio) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

b.request: For scans with `scans.scancount > 11` that have a matching site (`scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry`), group by `scans.zoneref` and `sites.phasefactor`; show each group’s site code, phase, unrounded average `scancount`, and unrounded average `pressratio`, ignoring null values in each average, ordered by average `pressratio` descending with nulls last, limited to 10 groups.
b.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, t.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount > 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.phasefactor ORDER BY AVG(s.pressratio) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
